sentences.japanese: 嫁にやらなくてはならない娘が３人いる。
sentences.english: I have three daughters to marry off.

sentences.japanese: どんな男にもそれ相当の嫁のきてがあるもの。
sentences.english: Every Jack must have his Jill.

sentences.japanese: 私の夫には、兄が２人います。そう、私は三男の嫁です。
sentences.english: My husband has two older brothers. That's right, I'm a third-son's wife.
